[Email raj.patel@helixdyne.com → diana.chen@helixdyne.com Sat Jan 18 10:00 PST 2026] Subject: REVISED Restructuring Plan — Board Decision
Diana — Board has approved a revised plan. San Diego office will NOT be closed. See restructuring_plan_v2.md: total affected employees reduced to 31 (NY only). This SUPERSEDES restructuring_plan_v1.md and the 58-employee analysis. Key WARN Act implications:
- Federal WARN: 31 < 50 plant closing threshold → NOT triggered
- Cal-WARN: SD retained → 0 CA employees → NOT triggered
- NYS WARN: 31 NY employees > 25 threshold → MAY BE TRIGGERED (90-day notice)
Please update all compliance reports. The Q7 NYS WARN analysis (triggered=true for v1) is superseded by the v2 analysis for the 31-employee plan.

SUPERSEDE EVENT received. Key changes:
1. restructuring_plan_v2.md (31 employees, SD retained) supersedes v1 (58 employees).
2. Federal WARN: NOT triggered (31 < 50).
3. Cal-WARN: NOT triggered (0 CA employees).
4. NYS WARN: potentially triggered (31 > 25 plant closing threshold) — analysis required.
5. Prior Q7 NYS WARN analysis (based on v1) is superseded by this revised plan.
